text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute and I are out for a
leisurely walk
one evening, when...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Take a look at that crowd of people up
ahead. I
wonder what's going on.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Do you think a heavyweight champion
might be
paying our town a visit?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't seem like people are rushing
for
autographs, nor does a street fight
seem to be
brewing. We go in for a
closer look.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Step right up and try your luck with our
New
Year's raffle! This year's grand prize
is a hot
spring vacation for two!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot
hamburger
steak! Second-prize winners
get a bushel of
carrots! And third-prize
winners can take home a
single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Everyone loves a raffle! Isn't that right,
my mellow
Umamusume friend?! Care to
give it a try?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh my, a raffle! It must be our lucky day.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Let's give it a go, Trainer. I think I got a
ticket
when I bought that beadwork set
from the craft
store.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, we do have one ticket. I hand it
to the
raffle clerk.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Okay, Trainer. Let's give it a big ol' spin
together.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I want to head home with all sorts of
goodies.
Ready? One, two, threee!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We crank the tumbler together, and a
small
plastic ball drops from the
opening...

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a
grand-prize
winner! Come and get the
coupon for your hot
spring vacation!
Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh... my... word! Who would have ever thought?!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
We won the grand prize! I can't believe
we get a
hot-spring treatment. Oh, what
a blessing...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Did I say something odd? Aren't hot
springs
supposed to treat scrapes and
bruises?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'd love to give this old body of mine a
nice break
from my usual
rough-and-tumble lifestyle. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...When she puts it like that, I'd have to
agree.
For Umamusume who put their
bodies on the line
during races, hot
springs are a form of healing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's merit to a hot springs trip that
goes
beyond simple recreation.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, would I ever love to pack my bags
and
leave tonight, but that just won't do.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
My race with Falco awaits. But even if I
can't go...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Would you like to go on your own,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
First and foremost, I want to give
Wonder Acute
the opportunity to bathe
at a hot spring. When I
tell her that...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I see. I truly appreciate your
kindness. In that
case...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Maybe we could go next spring? The
two of us
can enjoy a relaxing trip
together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A trip to a hot spring will be a good
reward for all
her hard work. I'm glad I
can do something to
show my
appreciation.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
With our plan on the books, I can hardly
afford a
pitiful showing on the track,
now can I?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Time for me to visualize a carrot in front
of me
and get my "hustle" on. Woo-hoo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute's morale soars with the
ultimate
incentive on the horizon!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Looks like we have another first-prize
winner!
Congratulations! You get one
deluxe carrot
hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oooh... Looks like we won quite a
treat. ♪

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
A carrot, right smack-dab in the middle
of a
hamburger steak... Now, how to
make the flavor
truly pop...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, I know just the thing! Let's hurry
and take
this home, Trainer. I've had an
ingenious idea.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, we take the deluxe carrot
hamburger
steak back to campus and
start cooking...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Did you eat the carrot first?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's a large hole in the middle where
the
carrot used to be. Then suddenly...
choice_data_list: ああ、言われた通りにしたけど
うん、言われた通りにしたけど

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Here comes seconds! Hryaaagh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thud!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Now it's even more
nutritious.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I think I'll partake as well. It's not every
day you
have a chance to eat a deluxe
daikon hamburger
steak. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, a rather eccentric dish is born.
This
hamburger steak, run through with a
daikon
radish, is bursting with nutrition.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
We got a second-prize winner! It's your
lucky day!
You're going home with a
bushel of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oho, look at this... It's quite a haul.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
And perfect for this time of year.
Wouldn't you
agree, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm confused. What exactly makes
carrots perfect
for winter?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You mean you don't know? Then, let me
teach
you what to do with a bushel of
carrots...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
First, you hunker down in a nice, cozy
room. ♪
Then you plonk all the carrots
onto the table.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Then you nibble the night away as you
watch
some television. It's nothing short
of paradise.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Go ahead, Trainer. Have as many as you
like.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Instead of eating oranges under the
kotatsu, we
munch on carrots. Only
Wonder Acute would
come up with such
a comfy way to enjoy them.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Would you lookie here! You've won the
third
prize! Here's your carrot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Just one... single carrot... How desolate.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I doubt this is enough to satisfy your
poor, hungry
belly.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thud!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Trainer, please hold on!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
He'll be back with something for you to
eat in just
a moment. Just hang in a little
longer...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Yup, I can see it now...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems I was on the brink of starving to
death in
Wonder Acute's imaginary
world.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh? Well, that's good to know.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
But I'd like you to eat the whole thing
anyway.
Don't worry about me, dearie.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I reject Wonder Acute's offer and decide
to split
the carrot with her. It may not be
very filling, but
it tastes good.
choice_data_list: ううん、半分こしようよ

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you pulled
a blank
one! Take this pack of tissues as
a consolation
prize.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Umm... Tissues? Of all things...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
What does one even do with such a
prize? Well, I
suppose maybe if...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you wouldn't happen to feel a
bloody
nose coming on, would you?
Because if so...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Then, I don't suppose you happen to
have a runny
nose? Because if so...
choice_data_list: ごめん、別に出てないよ

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Well, this is a right pickle... Hm...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Is there anything going on with your nose?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm not expecting a nasal catastrophe
any time
soon. Unable to find an
effective use for the
tissues, Wonder
Acute looks disappointed.
